findings.governingReading: An emptied porridge dish, Sakura's pajamas, and a wet towel lead Shirou to infer that he visited her earlier.
findings.explanation: The bowl is no longer identified as having held porridge, making the trace of sickroom care less specific. Shirou still infers that he visited Sakura.

findings.highlight: I should get ready to take a bath.
findings.governingReading: 風呂の準備してくる is an offered chore alongside taking care of laundry while Rin cooks.
findings.explanation: Preparing the household bath becomes getting ready to take a bath.

findings.highlight: I didn't touch the light switch.
findings.evidenceJa: スイッチ入れてもつかない
findings.governingReading: スイッチ入れてもつかない says they will not light even with the switch on.
findings.explanation: A failed attempt to turn the lights on becomes never touching the switch.

findings.highlight: Assassin might be able to breach the Emiya house's Bounded Field without setting it off!
findings.evidenceJa: アサシンなら衛宮邸の結界を苦もなく通り過ぎたじゃないか
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls Assassin having already passed the house's Bounded Field without difficulty that morning.
findings.explanation: An explicit reminder that Assassin already crossed the barrier becomes a statement that he might be able to do so. The preceding reference to that morning survives, but the event itself is no longer stated.

findings.evidenceJa: 作動するとは限らない
findings.governingReading: 作動するとは限らない corrects the prior certainty by saying not necessarily, not never.
findings.explanation: The barrier is not certain to activate becomes a categorical denial.

findings.evidenceJa: アレが影そのものなら
findings.governingReading: アレが影そのものなら makes the escape deduction conditional.
findings.explanation: If it is shadow itself becomes a stated fact about its composition.
